title: Addressing the Editor
description: How to write for a reader acting as Editor. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `editor` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Findings first, each with its evidence and severity
rules.description: Findings first, each with its evidence and severity. Never bury a blocker in prose; never dress an opinion as a finding.

source.quote: Author plus the authority to accept. Sees QA findings and decides which are real. Under time pressure and accountable for what lands, so they need the evidence before the argument.
